Name: Red Dancing Talon
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: The red-scaled dancing talons are among the proudest of the abishai, and channel the power of their Queen in the form of a sphere of deadly flame. These spheres of fire can serve as protection, an escape method, or a way to assault their targets. Among the abishai they possess incredible physical strength.

**RED DANCING TALON**
*Medium fiend (devil), lawful evil*
**Armor Class** 18 (natural armor)
**Hit Points** 85 (10d8 + 40)
**Speed** 30 ft., fly 50 ft.
**Quality Traits** Magic resist, magical
**STR** 22 (+6) | **DEX** 18 (+4) | **CON** 18 (+4) | **INT** 14 (+2) | **WIS** 17 (+3) | **CHA** 19 (+4)
**Saving Throws** Str +9, Con +5, Wis +6
**Skills** Investigation +5, Perception +6
**Resistances** cold; B/S/P (magical or silvered)
**Immunities** fire, poison
**Condition Immunities** poisoned
**Senses** darkvision 120 ft., devilsight 60 ft., passive Perception 16
**Languages** Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
**Challenge Rating** 6 (2,300 XP) **Prof Bonus** +3

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The fiend attacks once with its Claws and once with its Bite. It can replace its Bite with its Hellfire Sphere if it is available.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2d8 + 6 slashing damage.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (1d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 11 (3d6) fire damage.

***Hellfire Sphere (Recharge 5-6).*** The fiend creates a burning sphere of flame with a 5-foot-radius, centered on a point it can see within 30 feet. This sphere vanishes after 1 minute, and while it is manifested the fiend cannot recharge this feature.

The fiend must concentrate on this sphere as though it was a spell. Creatures that are inside are heavily obscured, and those outside are blinded to those inside.

Any creature who ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who make this save while inside the sphere itself have disadvantage on it.

**Bonus Actions**
***Fire Gate.*** The fiend teleports to any unoccupied space that is within its Hellfire Sphere, or the Hellfire Sphere of an ally within 30 feet.

***Move Sphere.*** If the fiend’s Hellfire Sphere is manifested, they can move it up to 30 feet in any direction. The sphere cannot turn while making this movement, and must only move in a straight line. Any creatures the sphere passes through while moving this way must make a Dexterity saving throw as though they ended their turn inside it, taking damage as described in Hellfire Sphere’s description.
